title: Honeybadger and Cub with Genesis Block
description: Honeybadger and Cub with Genesis Block by TJ Murphy. Watercolor pastel. Available.
story: I displayed this painting at the 2026 Bitcoin Film Festival. For me, it represents Bitcoin’s protective and caring nature. The honey badger is often used as a Bitcoin mascot because it is fierce and undeterred by opposition. Here, the honey badger protects its cub.
There is a strong thread of pronatalism in the Bitcoin movement. I think that may come from a long-term outlook and a low time preference: a concern for the future and for the next generation.
Behind the honey badger is the Genesis block. I wrote it in clear wax before applying the watercolor, using the wax as a resist.

title: Sunrise on Rainier with Eagle
description: Sunrise on Rainier with Eagle by TJ Murphy. Watercolor pastel. Not for sale.
story: This is the view from my favorite place: a beach on Lake Washington looking south toward Mount Rainier. A few times a week, I bring a blanket to the flat rocks at the north corner of the shore. I sit there, stare at the mountain, meditate, and practice breathing exercises.
This view inspired me to learn to paint with watercolors. I had filled my journal with ink sketches, but I wanted to capture the luminosity of the sky. Watercolor was how I began to learn.

Bald eagles sometimes fly overhead and catch fish in the water. One day I saw an eagle begin to swoop down and pointed it out. Everyone on the beach watched. When it caught the fish, we all cheered. The eagle turned and gave a cry.
I’ve painted this view dozens of times. This is the last iteration.

image.alt: Sunrise on Rainier with Eagle by TJ Murphy

title: Warszawska Syrenka
description: Warszawska Syrenka by TJ Murphy. Watercolor pastel. Available.
story: I made this poster for the Bitcoin Film Festival in Warsaw, Poland. It depicts the Syrenka, Warsaw’s protector spirit. Her statue stands in the Old Town Market Square. The Old Town was devastated during the war, then rebuilt from paintings and photographs to resemble its prewar form as closely as possible.
The hussar wings behind her represent Polish valor. The Bitcoin logo on her shield represents the tools we now have to liberate humanity from oppression.
